T: Strong side. Left side. Dinner side.
D: A newly integrated high school football team in 1971 Virginia comes together under a new coach.
P: Serve the main after the big game.
S: Ham and cheese sandwiches for the long days at football camp. Butter 8 slices of bread and fill with 150g ham and 4 slices of cheddar.
Hot dogs with mustard and relish, the food stand at the Titans' home games. Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes and tuck into 8 buns.
M: Southern fried chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy. Dredge 1.2kg chicken pieces in 200g seasoned flour and fry at 170C for 14 minutes.
W: Warm peach cobbler with cream. Tip 800g drained peaches into a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour and 100g sugar, add milk, spoon over and bake at 190C for 30 minutes.
K: Sweet iced tea with lemon. Steep 6 tea bags in 1L boiling water with 120g sugar.

s.how: Butter 8 slices of bread and fill with 150g ham and 4 slices of cheddar. Cut in halves and pile on a plate. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes and tuck into 8 buns. Serve with mustard and relish. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Dredge 1.2kg chicken pieces in 200g seasoned flour and fry at 170C for 14 minutes. Serve with mash from 800g potatoes and gravy. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Tip 800g drained peaches into a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour and 100g sugar, add milk, spoon over and bake at 190C for 30 minutes.

d.how: Steep 6 tea bags in 1L boiling water with 120g sugar. Add 500ml cold water, chill and serve over ice with lemon. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
